Hi Nathan,

Thank you for your patience. You've been waiting on this since you sent the RMA form on October 8, and I'm sorry it has taken this long.

The store credit route is set up. I've put the full $137.32 you paid for the GekkoAxe on your return as store credit. It goes onto your account automatically as soon as our warehouse books your unit in. When it's there, order the Hammer BC04 on the site and the credit comes off at checkout.

You're right about the delivery. UPS shows your box arrived on November 4, but our warehouse hasn't checked it in yet, and the credit can't go out until they do. I've asked a colleague to chase the warehouse to get it booked in. They'll pick it up tomorrow and you'll hear back in this thread.

Best,
Sarah
Any update on locating the return?

Hi Nathan,

Not yet, I'm afraid. I checked again just now and our warehouse still hasn't booked your GekkoAxe in. UPS shows it delivered on November 4, so it's at the building. It just hasn't been checked in against your return, Shop····.

A colleague has the request to get the warehouse to find it and book it in. They pick it up this morning, and you'll get their answer by email in this thread.

Your $137.32 store credit is already set up. It goes onto your account automatically as soon as the warehouse books the unit in. You don't need to do anything else on your side.

Sorry this is dragging on after waiting since October 8.

Best,
Sarah
